title: vibe-delivery repo profile (.claude/vibe-delivery.yaml)
description: Everything site- or repo-specific the vibe-delivery skill needs. The skill itself carries none of it.

repo.description: Short repo name, used in labels and worktree names.

remote.description: Git remote name (usually origin). null or absent with no_remote: true.

no_remote.description: The repo has no remote: nothing is pushed, no MR is opened, the merge stage always stops with needs_owner_decision.

worktree_root.description: Directory for this repo's worktrees; ~ is expanded.

files.description: Shared tracking files. Stage only your own hunks in them.

plan_entry_file.description: Where SETUP writes the plan's bookkeeping_entry.

convention.description: How entries are written and ticked in this repo.

open_command.description: Shell template the MR merge stage (and only it) runs to open the MR. Placeholders, substituted shell-quoted: {source}, {target}, {title}, {description_file}.

command.description: Shell template the MR merge stage runs to merge. Placeholders: {iid}, {sha} (the gated head).

mr_exists_command.description: Shell template run in a worktree; must print the number of MRs (any state) whose source branch is {branch}. vibe-run.sh fails a run whose branch has one, since only the merge stage may open MRs.

lock.description: Lock name; runs of packages with needs_vm hold it for their whole vibe session (one user at a time).

cmd.description: Run with bash -c in the worktree root. {touched_dirs} expands to ./dir per touched directory matched by paths.

paths.description: Run only when a touched path matches (bash patterns, * spans /). Absent = always.

level.description: package = per work package and after each integration; full = MR prep.

failure_patterns.description: ERE with capture group 1 = a failure id (test name, package).

fatal_patterns.description: ERE; any match makes a failure real even if all ids are known.

ids.description: Failure ids (as failure_patterns extract them) that fail on the default branch too.

signature.description: Text seen in the log, for humans.

verified.description: Where and when this was reproduced on the default branch.

recheck.description: One targeted shell command, run from the repository root of a default-branch checkout, that reproduces this failure: it exits non-zero while the failure persists (for Go, one `go test -run '^<id>$' <package>` on one of the ids). Pre-flight runs it; if it passes, the entry is stale and must be removed before launch, or a regression would pass as known.

house_rules.description: Other repo rules every agent and vibe prompt must carry.
